- Face-to-face examination with abdominal and pelvic assessment arranged.
- Repeat pregnancy test advised today; patient instructed to seek urgent review if positive, or if symptoms worsen or unable to tolerate fluids.

- Repeat pregnancy test today; call for urgent review if positive.
- Safety net advice: return sooner if pain worsens, unable to take fluids, or other concerning symptoms.
- No medications prescribed at this time.
- No pathology tests, referrals, or other investigations ordered yet (pending physical exam).

- Pelvic inflammatory disease (Moderate likelihood): Lower abdominal pain, light bleeding, recent sexual activity; minimized by absence of fever, systemic illness, and minimal discharge.
